what: Distribution of decision-chain length over the 218-item deep exam, stacked by problem family (nested induction / lemma tower / sum-of-squares cascade), with the per-family compile-and-judge pass rate of the model-produced chain.
one_line_reading: Chain length is 5-9 steps with mean 6.12; the two synthetic families are rigid (5 and 9 steps) and certify perfectly, while the 181-item inequality cascade spreads over 5-7 steps and carries every failure.

source.role: per-item chain read-out; gold_ops defines the step count

method: step count = len(gold_ops) on the gold_chain arm; identical gold_ops in both arms so the count is arm-independent. Panel (b) uses the certified flag of the stored_chain arm (chain_src='gen34_slotA').
caveats: gold_chain is certified 218/218 by construction, so panel (b) deliberately uses the stored_chain arm; do not quote 218/218 as a capability number.
the SPEC-suggested mean 6.12 is reproduced exactly (6.1193 on both arms).
family labels in-figure are English (Nested induction / Lemma tower / Sum-of-squares cascade).
